messages:
Maya Patel: Quick thread to lock GA cut and acceptance bullets for the unified API surfaces (chat/completions, embeddings, rerank). Need this in the PRD before Friday.
Liam Chen: top-level Q: do we call the deterministic rerank flag `stable_ordering` or `deterministic_rerank`? we should pick one and use it in SDKs/docs.
Anika Gomez: prefer `stable_ordering` (shorter). default false. mark as pilot-only for first wave.
Ravi Singh: infra note: enabling stable_ordering requires session pinning + longer KV retention. pilots will need dedicated pools or we hit tail latency.
Jordan Brooks: SDK impact: add optional `response_profile` enum: ["balanced","throughput","accuracy","stable_ordering"]. sample snippet:
```json
{ "model": "redwood-chat-3", "response_profile": "stable_ordering", "client_hints": {"max_latency_ms": 250} }
```
Priya Nair: From customers: they want per-route cost in billing and a header when fallback happens. Also they asked for clearer chunking guidance for long docs.
Maya Patel: Proposed GA acceptance bullets (draft):
- Contract stability: all new params are additive; `response_profile` additive enum.
- Performance: hosted GA targets (95th): chat <= 180ms, embeddings <= 130ms, rerank <= 280ms on GA traffic mix. Dedicated pools can be tighter.
- Quality gates:
  - completions A/B top-1 swap <= 1.2% vs baseline on seed set
  - embeddings mean cosine delta <= 0.012 after quantization on pinned corpora
  - rerank nondet top-1 swap <= 2%; stable_ordering pilot <= 0.6%
- Observability: per-request header `x-redwood-cost-credits`; fallback header `x-redwood-fallback: <reason>` when triggered
- Failover: documented fallback behavior: if rerank backend unavailable, return original ranking + `x-redwood-fallback: rerank_unavailable`
Liam Chen: add hard QA blocks: any quantization setting that causes embedding delta >0.02 on pinned corpora is blocked for GA. QA to run nightly sweep.
Anika Gomez: research will run a quantization matrix (8/8/4, 6/6/4, 4/4/4) tonight and post metrics. Anything >0.012 drift we flag for mitigation.
Ravi Singh: infra ops edge cases to call out in the PRD:
- sticky sessions for stable_ordering to avoid non-determinism
- KV eviction priority: pin stable_ordering session keys for 120s post-request
- pre-warm dedicated pilot pool when scheduled heavy traffic expected
Jordan Brooks: SDK UX notes: when `response_profile=stable_ordering` and customer on free tier, SDK should emit a non-blocking warning: "stable_ordering increases latency and cost". Console opt-in flow for pilots.
Priya Nair: pilot candidates: Meridian Insights, Atlas Analytics, NovaSearch. They requested deterministic output + per-route billing. I'll coordinate invites after product locks the gating.
Maya Patel: Edge cases to document in spec:
- Very large context (> 40k tokens): return 413 `context_too_large` + link to chunking helper and example code.
- Embedding payloads with NaN/Inf: 400 with an example error body and remediation steps.
- Empty chat messages array: 422 with guidance showing minimal valid payload.
- Client cancels mid-stream: server should emit `x-rw-stream-finalized: true` header and mark cache eligible for reuse after a 3s cooldown.
Liam Chen: tests & gating:
- small eval harness for rerank top-1/top-3 stability + embedding drift; QA owns repo.
- perf replay: synthetic GA traffic profile to validate 95th SLOs before canary.
Anika Gomez: research to add quantization acceptance tests to spec and publish nightly report. If any model crosses thresholds we remove from GA candidate list.
Ravi Singh: risk: tokenization changes for new rerank variants. Suggest a hard freeze of GA candidate model list by Tue COB to avoid onboarding delays.
Maya Patel: agree. propose freeze Tue. research sign-off required before freeze.
Jordan Brooks: rollout plan: internal -> pilot cohort (stable_ordering allowed) -> 5% public canary (nondet only) -> GA (nondet default, stable_ordering opt-in paid). Monitor for 72h each band.
Priya Nair: also request adding `x-redwood-route-id` header so pilots can validate per-route billing in their telemetry.
Maya Patel: owners: product=Maya, infra=Ravi, research=Anika, SDK=Jordan, QA=Liam, pilots=Priya. Next steps:
- Anika: post quant results by EOD tonight.
- Ravi: open infra tickets for pilot pool + KV tuning.
- Jordan: draft SDK PR + changelog (minor bump).
- Liam: create eval harness + baseline scripts.
- Priya: prepare pilot invite emails.
Maya Patel: blockers?
Ravi Singh: main blocker is tokenization changes. If research approves models today we can hit the proposed freeze.
Anika Gomez: running the final sweep now; will post sign-off or issues.
Maya Patel: great. I'll update the PRD with these acceptance bullets and owners and circulate to GTM/pilots. Thanks all. :rocket:
